subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Only two people sit between F and B when counted from the right of F. Only two people sit between B and A when counted from the right of B. Only three people sit between F and E when counted from the right of F. D sits to the immediate left of C. How many people sit between F and G when counted from the left of F?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1. Only two people sit between F and B when counted from the right of F.

2. Only two people sit between B and A when counted from the right of B.

3. Only three people sit between F and E when counted from the right of F.

4. D sits to the immediate left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2658961c2764127a1b6411d3d01ce7d747c7adc7417b34cc420f584fba5ed15f.png] 

G, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3bfd91904b2f273e963b8ef6d5754fc0701011accea13bdff71fb9a13c64cee.png] 

Thus, 1 people sit between F and G when counted from the left of F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
